استجيروا (form X)
# اُسْتُجِيرُوا (ustujīrū) /us.tu.d͡ʒiː.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَجَارَ (istajāra)
# اِسْتَجِيرُوا (istajīrū) /is.ta.d͡ʒiː.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَجَارَ (istajāra)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
